from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialLineItem(BaseModel):
    """A specific financial line item extracted from one document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Company name appearing in this document")
    line_item_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the financial line item, e.g., '一年内到期的非流动负债'")
    value: float | None = Field(description="Numeric value of the line item")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g., '元'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Report period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    source_document: str | None = Field(description="Document identifier")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_line_items: list[FinancialLineItem]
